description:
Run Python for 3+ tool calls with loops, branches or output filtering. Use direct calls for single tools, results requiring full reasoning, or user interaction. The session kernel preserves variables, imports and data between calls; reuse them. Timeout or interruption loses that state.

Available via `from hermes_tools import ...`:

  web_search(query: str, limit: int = 5)
    Returns {"data": {"web": [{"url", "title", "description"}, ...]}}
  web_extract(urls: list[str], char_limit: int = None) -> dict
    Returns {"results": [{"url", "title", "content", "error"}, ...]}; content is unsummarized markdown.
    Over char_limit (default 15000): head/tail plus full-text file path in footer.
  read_file(path: str, offset: int = 1, limit: int = 2000) -> dict
    Lines are 1-indexed. Returns {"content": "...", "total_lines": N}
  write_file(path: str, content: str) -> dict
    Full replacement; read existing files first or the write is refused.
  search_files(pattern: str, target="content", path=".", file_glob=None, limit=50, order="discovery") -> dict
    target: "content" or "files" (names). Returns {"matches": [...]}
  patch(path: str, old_string: str, new_string: str, replace_all: bool = False) -> dict
  terminal(command: str, timeout=None, workdir=None) -> dict
    Foreground only (no background/pty). Returns {"output": "...", "exit_code": N}

Limits: 5 minutes, 50 tool calls. Stdout over 50KB shows head/tail plus a full-output file path.

Runs in the session cwd with the active venv/conda Python (VIRTUAL_ENV/CONDA_PREFIX), otherwise Hermes's Python. Check imports before relying on project packages.

Import helpers from hermes_tools: json_parse(text) tolerates terminal JSON; shell_quote(s) quotes shell arguments; retry(fn, max_attempts=3, delay=2) uses exponential backoff.
name: execute_code

code.description: Python code to execute; print your final result to stdout.

reset.description: Discard the kernel's persistent state and start fresh before running this code.
